overall.label: Strong
overall.meaning: Tests pass, no serious finding is open and the standards are well covered.

findings.title: On the sample tenant most Build new types cannot plan: it carries no network applications, DNS gateways, cloud application catalogue, Cloud App Control rule types, ZPA provisioning keys or inspection controls, and its in-memory store does not model ZPA policy rule writes or Client Connector's edit endpoints; each builder says plainly what it could not read and writes nothing
findings.fix: Kept open: the builders keep failing closed on the sample with the reason; carrying the catalogues first needs a query-aware, multi-path sample write model
findings.reason: Not cheap: cloudApplications/policy answers per app_class (the sample ignores query parameters, so Path and Data Flow answers would change), CAC ids collide across rule types in the sample's writes, ZPA rules need a second path; ZCC edit, ZDX config and AI Guard are assumed or OneAPI-only

findings.title: An Undo spec can name any custom category / segment to delete when it gives its exact current URL / domain list
findings.fix: Needs all four write gates and shows in the preview; the category or segment must match exactly and not be used by a rule in scope

findings.title: approved_digest is an unkeyed hash: it binds an approval to its plan against code paths, not against someone who can rewrite change_requests.json
findings.fix: The store is owner-only (0600); a keyed MAC would need a server secret and is out of this slice

findings.title: Local names shadow route functions (digests_list's `health`, flow_scenario's `import dlp_efficacy`); local scope only, behaviour correct
findings.fix: Accepted: no rename (renaming risks the response code paths for no behaviour change)

findings.title: /api/checks and /api/checks/export with an unknown scope list the whole static catalog
findings.fix: Accepted: the catalog is static and public to the UI; no tenant is read

findings.title: /api/dlp-packs/journey, /baseline-status and /api/remediation/execute sign in without a Scope page selection
findings.fix: Accepted: documented exemptions in tests/test_scope_rule_routes.py EXEMPT (an operator-picked pack or check)

findings.title: Benchmarks and compliance percentages use Python round() (half to even): 62.5% shows 62, 87.5% shows 88
findings.fix: kept: the engine score and compliance alignment use the same rounding, so the pages agree

findings.title: In 'remove everything' mode an assessor-style tag at the very end of a customer's own description ('[Bob pack q3 v2]') is indistinguishable from a deploy tag
findings.fix: Accepted: the operator reviews every object in the preview (plan_hash-bound) before confirming; a tag needs the deploy's exact shape and position

findings.title: Endpoint application group body sends 'resources' and 'channel'; the SDK 1.11.3 model names end_point_applications (raw request; wire field assumed from a live tenant, not verifiable here)
findings.fix: Left as is: changing the wire format without a tenant could break a working deploy; verify on a lab tenant

findings.title: Running jobs are not capped (only finished ones: MAX_FINISHED_JOBS); write runs are one per tenant (tenant_run)
findings.fix: Single-user local tool; write runs serialised per tenant

findings.title: Readiness reports a read-only role before a missing licence for a write kind that has a permission to check (web), while a kind without one (email) says not licensed
findings.fix: kept: tests/test_qa6_verdicts_reports.py encodes this precedence; the oracle in this area's tests records it

findings.title: readiness.ZIA_PERMS lists URL_FILTERING_CONTROL and CLOUD_APP_CONTROL, which SDK 1.11.3's admin_roles docs do not name
findings.fix: kept as aliases only (never the first spelling, so no step asks for them); test-enforced

findings.title: The sample answers no Client Connector endpoint the SDK does not document (appPostureInfo, webMachineTunnel, webZPNModuleMode, webBrowserProtectionProfile, getLastAppPostureFields), nor sandbox quota, ZTW or the CBI config paths
findings.fix: kept: their real answers are unverified, and the checks treat 404 as 'not in the public API'

findings.title: Some controls have no stable hook of their own (offline_tenant.js snapshot buttons, find_anything.js card buttons, pov.js intake fields and report buttons, flow_pages.js walk buttons, panel.js detail buttons, zcc_fleet.js details) so their entries use structural selectors or one entry per family
findings.fix: Entries exist and pass; adding ids would edit files owned by other areas. Suggested hooks are in this record's checks

findings.title: The Bypass report's aggregated 'bypassed' lists and summary include rules whose state is DISABLED
findings.fix: Kept on purpose: the inventory is for auditors, every item carries its rule state, and risk flags already require ENABLED

findings.title: Log Analyzer facts show the device user's e-mail address from the logs
findings.fix: Needed to identify the device; shown on screen only, never logged or written to disk

findings.title: The live feed polls by creation time, so an incident ingested after its window passed is not shown live
findings.fix: Documented limit of a creation-time window; the full report reads the whole period

findings.title: check_locks() removes a run lock that is still flock-held when the PID in its note is not alive here (a holder in another PID namespace sharing the data folder would lose its lock)
findings.fix: kept: the designed case is an orphaned fd inherited by a child of a crashed run, pinned by tests/test_self_heal.py::test_stale_run_lock_whose_owner_is_gone_is_released; the container and a local install do not share a data folder by default

findings.title: The updater installs requirements.lock from the pulled tree; a package without a wheel would be built from its hashed sdist
findings.fix: kept: --require-hashes --no-deps pins every artifact by SHA-256, and the pulled tree is the code the app runs next anyway; --only-binary would break platforms without wheels

findings.title: check_permissions() follows symbolic links when it narrows a store's mode
findings.fix: kept: the targets live in the 0700 data folder and only files owned by this user are changed

findings.title: Overlapping port ranges in one CSV row (80-90, 85-95) are sent as given, not merged
findings.fix: Accepted: whether ZPA refuses overlapping ranges in one segment is not verifiable without a tenant; ZPA's own answer is shown.

findings.title: A wildcard on a public suffix such as *.co.uk is not recognised as over-broad
findings.fix: Accepted: needs the public suffix list, which the app does not ship; single-label TLD wildcards are refused.

findings.title: On the Data Security Portfolio Framework, technique cards of channels the reader has not switched on are drawn at 20% opacity (about 1.2:1)
findings.fix: accepted: the cards are inactive (not focusable, pointer-events none) until a channel is chosen, and SC 1.4.3 exempts inactive components; documented in docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md

findings.title: B104 (bind to all interfaces, medium) on 0.0.0.0 compared to word the start-up address and a notice (dlp_api_server.main), as an address-family probe (workload_path._is_address) and in the standalone smoke test's hostile environment and address compare: nothing binds
findings.reason: False positive: each literal moved to one named constant with # nosec B104 and its reason (3 suppressions for 5 hits); the real bind checks are security.py's and are tested

findings.title: B314 (ElementTree.fromstring on untrusted XML, medium) in vendor_migrate (2) and tools/quality_score.run_from_junit
findings.reason: False positive: each parse runs only after _refuse_dtd refused any DOCTYPE or ENTITY in any encoding, on input size-capped first; # nosec B314 with that reason on each

findings.title: B202 (tarfile.extractall without validation, high) on tools/smoke_standalone.unpack's zipfile.extractall; B310 (urlopen scheme, medium) on its http://127.0.0.1 requests
findings.reason: False positives in a developer tool: bandit sees tarfile imported (the tar branch already uses filter=data); zipfile strips absolute and .. paths and makes no links; the URLs are the tool's own loopback ones

findings.title: B608 (SQL built from strings, medium/low) on app_update's error message: 'update stopped ... set aside' matched bandit's UPDATE ... SET pattern
findings.fix: app_update.update: message reworded
findings.reason: False positive (the app has no SQL): the message now says put aside, so no suppression is needed

findings.title: Refused (401/403) reads reported as PASS by 11 checks and as REVIEW by about 40 more
findings.fix: Every read goes through _g, so a refused read is an INFO naming HTTP 403: not permitted, outside the score

findings.title: Checks judged reads the role was refused (401/403): FW.8 and AI.6 passed, ~69 checks said 'No X configured', 'not accessible' notes counted informational
findings.fix: permission guard (zscaler_full_checks.permission_guarded/guard_registry) wraps every check of the six platform registries and the SaaS/Email checks: a scored result built on a refused read becomes INFO 'Not permitted' (permissions.is_denied wording)

findings.title: Engine DLP registry (outside slice): 11 checks PASS on HTTP 403, e.g. MC.12 counts the error body as a rule
findings.fix: The permission guard moved into the engine and wraps REG after its splices, so API, MCP and CLI runs fail closed on a 401/403 read (the 11 named engine checks were already not permitted; 1.27/1.28 were not). Also ...::test_an_engine_check_built_on_a_refused_read_is_not_permitted

findings.title: Removal deleted untagged customer objects that only shared a pack or legacy name (e.g. a customer's own 'PCI - High' engine)
findings.fix: A name-only match is kept with a plain reason; only objects carrying the app's provenance tag (or a deployment record's id+name) are removed; the rule picker removes the rest by hand

findings.title: Evaluate All enable step could PUT a one-field body to /zia/advancedSettings, resetting every other advanced setting
findings.fix: Removed the minimal-body PUT; only GET-modify-PUT of the whole object remains

findings.title: The app profile's IP bypasses were never compared with the destination: 10.1.2.3 (excluded 10.0.0.0/8) reported tunnelled and enforced
findings.fix: An IP destination inside one is bypassed with the entry named; a host name exclusion bypasses that host; public IP bypasses on a host name are stated as an assumption

findings.title: Z-Tunnel 2.0 packet tunnel exclusions and inclusions were never read: an excluded address was reported tunnelled to ZIA
findings.fix: Read from the app profile and applied when the network's mode is Z-Tunnel 2.0; also counted when a scoped profile differs

findings.title: Prefix delete and policy rules of prefix 'pov' took the objects of another build 'pov-2' (names also start with 'pov-')
findings.fix: Another build's longer prefix is recognised from the builder's fixed object names and excluded (deny by default).

findings.title: Review & remediate 'Add Description to a Rule' sent PATCH, which the raw client turns into a PUT carrying only the description: ZIA's PUT replaces the rule, so the rule's name, action, conditions and engines were wiped (or the write refused); its firewall option named a path that does not exist (firewallRules)
findings.fix: the recipe is a read-modify-write PUT (merge): the rule is read and sent back whole with only its description changed; the option is firewallFilteringRules

findings.title: Plain HTTP (TCP/80, http://) was reported as 'encrypted, DLP blind' with no SSL rule, and as 'decrypted' with one
findings.fix: The trace takes plain HTTP as having no TLS: SSL hop not applicable, content visible, headline says unencrypted (plain HTTP)

findings.title: A Cloud Firewall rule naming only IPv6 destination groups matched every destination (a definite wrong block of IPv4 traffic)
findings.fix: destIpv6Groups and srcIpv6Groups are criteria: never an IPv4 address, unknown for IPv6 (their list is not read)

findings.title: URL filtering, File Type Control and Web DLP rule protocols were ignored by the trace: an HTTP-only block rule was said to block HTTPS
findings.fix: The trace applies each rule's protocols (one shared helper with the module criteria)

findings.title: Web DLP excluded users, groups and departments were ignored: definite 'enforce' for excluded users, and the what-if for an excluded group still enforced
findings.fix: Exclusions are scope (conditional for any user) and a negated what-if dimension

findings.title: Fix recipes created their rule ENABLED by default (FW-01: BLOCK_DROP at order 1, live on apply)
findings.fix: Every recipe's state field defaults to DISABLED; plan() fills defaults server-side

findings.title: RULE-DESC (PATCH) fell back to a PUT of the description alone on the raw client, which has no patch(): the PUT would replace the whole rule
findings.fix: Read the rule, merge the changed fields, PUT it back whole; send nothing if the read fails (assumed: ZIA has no PATCH). The dead PATCH branch is gone (a PATCH recipe is refused, nothing sent); the plan and dry run say the rule is read and sent back whole

findings.title: Four-eyes bypass without SSO: a request filed as 'local, no UI token' could be approved as 'local UI token' (same person, UI gate toggled)
findings.fix: A local identity, the app itself or 'unknown' is never accepted as the approver while four-eyes is on

findings.title: Proposals: an applied, approved or resolved proposal could be approved again, so an applied change could be applied a second time
findings.fix: Status-based refusals: an applied change is rolled back first; approved/resolved are not re-approved

findings.title: A saved profile's, the environment's or tenant_config.json's secret was paired with a typed vanity domain or client id of another tenant (the secret went to that tenant's sign-in host)
findings.fix: _same_sign_in: a stored sign-in fills blanks only when no typed vanity domain, client id or username names another tenant; otherwise fail closed with the missing field

findings.title: Checks that read nothing, or found nothing to judge, counted as passes (10.4, MC.12, 8.5 with no enabled rule, 6.1 with no device)
findings.fix: 10.4 reads devices, MC.12 is informational, 8.5 with zero rules is REVIEW, 6.1 with no device is INFO

findings.title: 50+ checks raised on null, numeric or non-object tenant records (state None, numeric names, bool urlCategories, int fileTypes)
findings.fix: _g keeps objects only; _s/_on/_lst read text and list fields defensively

findings.title: Efficacy engine-expression parser ignored the SDK format ((D63.S > 1)), so every custom dictionary was flagged unused by engines
findings.fix: Parse \bD\(?\s*(\d+) (SDK and legacy forms), distinct ids in order

findings.title: Efficacy hid refused reads: a 403 on rules flagged every engine unused, a 403 on dictionaries looked like an empty tenant
findings.fix: read_errors lists each failed read; a refused rule read is unknown (None), never unused

findings.title: Rich markup and terminal escape injection from tenant text in the CLI report (OSC 8 hyperlink, styling, ESC sequences)
findings.fix: _term strips control characters and escapes Rich markup for every tenant string printed

findings.title: zcc_evaluation (spliced into sections 1, 6, 12): 1.16-1.23 PASS on zero active app profiles ('all 0 profile(s)'), and 1.27/1.28 call a 403 'not readable' without the status, so it is not classed as not permitted. 1.24-1.26 also pass on zero forwarding profiles (same pattern, not in this patch).
findings.fix: zcc_evaluation: zero active app profiles (1.15-1.23) or zero forwarding profiles (1.24-1.26) is INFO 'could not be assessed'; 1.27/1.28 name the HTTP status of an unreadable read (one read, not two). Also ...::test_an_unreadable_company_or_privacy_read_names_its_status

findings.title: Redacting a JSON Web Token took quadratic time: an echoed error with a long '-eyJ-eyJ…' run (80 KB: 2 s, 200 KB: 12 s) held the job thread
findings.fix: Find JWTs per run of token characters, each dot-separated part once (linear), with the old pattern as the test oracle

findings.title: mask_secrets missed a secret echoed base64-encoded, as HTTP Basic 'id:secret', or percent-encoded byte by byte
findings.fix: secret_forms adds base64 and every-byte percent forms; mask_secrets masks Basic pairs of client_id/client_secret and username/password

findings.title: redact_tokens missed a URL-encoded bearer (Bearer%20…), OAuth access/refresh/id_token fields and HTTP Basic credentials
findings.fix: URL-encoded separators, token-field and Basic patterns (Basic only when it decodes to an 'id:secret' pair)

findings.title: SSO took the ID token's algorithm from its own header, not pinned to the published key's (PS256 accepted for an RS256 key; 'none'/HS256 refused only by library accident)
findings.fix: Allow-list of public-key algorithms, which must equal the JWK's alg; kty and use checked

findings.title: SSO accepted an ID token with no expiry (or no iat or sub): a sign-in token valid for ever
findings.fix: exp, iat, iss, aud, sub required (OIDC Core 3.1.3.7), 60 s leeway, plain-language errors

findings.title: Pending SSO sign-ins grew without bound from the unauthenticated login route, and were swept without a lock
findings.fix: MAX_PENDING_LOGINS (oldest dropped) under _PENDING_LOCK

findings.title: The audit log followed a symbolic link planted at its name and never tightened a log made wider than 0600
findings.fix: O_NOFOLLOW on open, fchmod 0600 on every line

findings.title: safe_files.private_open wrote through a symbolic link planted at the file's name
findings.fix: O_NOFOLLOW on every private_open

findings.title: A remembered secret stayed in the OS credential store after it was forgotten or its profile deleted, when the profile file no longer held the store marker (moved to the file opt-in)
findings.fix: _forget_secret always deletes from the store (overwrites with nothing when refused); a file-kept secret deletes the store's older copy

findings.title: SdkClient logged and returned SDK error text unmasked (an echoed Bearer token or the client secret)
findings.fix: _sdk_call redacts tokens; get() masks the client's own secrets in every error

findings.title: Sitemap regex backtracked cubically on unclosed sitemap tags (18 KB = 4 s, 94 KB > 2 min): a hostile sitemap hangs the crawl
findings.fix: one linear pass over sitemap open/close tags; 8 MB parses in 0.16 s

findings.title: zscaler_update_check._safe_get reads the whole answer into memory with no size cap (outside this slice); the crawler's 8 MB/2 MB caps apply only after the download
findings.fix: Already fixed on integrate/w6 (update-heal slice): _safe_get streams with stream=True and _read_capped refuses an answer (declared or read) past MAX_BODY_BYTES (64 MB, sized for SDK wheels); no change needed

findings.title: RBAC.12 'Stale admin accounts' always passed: SDK UserRecord has no last-login field, so no evidence read as 'none stale'
findings.fix: no reported login time is INFO (not assessed); clock injectable (_now); booleans are not timestamps

findings.title: AI.9/AI.10 passed on substrings: 'Weekly report' (repo), 'Barcode' (code), 'Company confidential' (pan)
findings.fix: _has_any matches whole words

findings.title: Compliance mapping cited wrong control ids (ISO A.8.22, PCI DSS 10.7/9.7/1.4.5, CIS 13.10/10.7, CMMC 3.12.4, AU.L3-3.3.1e, HIPAA disposal, 800-171 Rev 3 label)
findings.fix: ids and titles corrected against the framework texts; format regex per framework tested for every control

findings.title: Benchmarks filed sections 11 and 12 under Client Connector and SaaS/Email channels under Other, missing from the Coverage stage
findings.fix: prefix-only matching; Ch.C/Ch.D added to the DLP programme area and Coverage stage

findings.title: SaaS matrix: an INACTIVE tenant counted as active ('ACTIVE' in 'INACTIVE')
findings.fix: status list compared by whole token

findings.title: D.6 / C.3 PASSed while their tenant list read was refused
findings.fix: SaaS/Email checks spliced into the engine registry through the permission guard

findings.title: Legacy tag check was a substring test: removing pack 'x' also matched objects tagged '[DLP-Check pack x_more v1]'
findings.fix: The legacy tag must name the pack id whole (followed by space, ']' or end)

findings.title: A pack or pick-mode removal with an empty plan_hash skipped the stale-plan check and deleted an unreviewed plan (including 'remove everything')
findings.fix: remove() and remove_selected() refuse an empty plan_hash; a deployment undo stays bound to its record

findings.title: plan_hash bound only item statuses and tenant object counts: a pack file edited after preflight, or a tenant rule swapped for another, still applied
findings.fix: The hash covers each item's definition content and the tenant's object names, ids and rule orders

findings.title: Pack files read from disk were trusted: a non-list, scalar entries, wrong field types, deep nesting or a huge file crashed preflight and removal (HTTP 500 with a Python error)
findings.fix: pack_deploy.load_pack_file: 8 MB cap, nesting cap, list-of-objects shape and a per-file field schema; a bad file is a plain blocked plan before the tenant is read

findings.title: Proposal apply re-read the rule before writing but did not compare it with the preview: a change made in between was overwritten
findings.fix: The write is refused when the field (or the rule id behind the name) changed since the preview

findings.title: A rollback with no recorded value (or a proposal with no target) normalised None to '' and would send an empty action/state to ZIA
findings.fix: A missing value stays None and the preview refuses the step

findings.title: deployments.json read-modify-write had no lock: two runs finishing together lost a record (and with it the undo)
findings.fix: One module lock around every read-modify-write of the store

findings.title: The from-tenant name filter was compiled as a regular expression and run on tenant names: '(a+)+$' hung the worker (ReDoS)
findings.fix: Literal, case-folded substring with optional ^prefix / suffix$; no regex is ever compiled from it

findings.title: A tenant dictionary name such as 'Py) OR (D:CREDIT_CARD Signal' was pasted into the rebuilt engine expression, rewriting its logic in every tenant the pack is deployed to
findings.fix: Only names that read back as exactly one D:<name> term (dlp_importer.find_refs) and hold no control characters are used; others are listed as ignored

findings.title: Client Connector passwords named ...Pass (exitPass, uninstallPass, ziaDisablePass ...) reached the Client Connector workbook
findings.fix: is_secret treats 'pass' (and 'passphrase') as a secret word, per SDK 1.11.3 zcc/models/manage_pass.py; bypass settings stay

findings.title: Rule id from an uploaded rule list was written into the PUT/DELETE request path (path steering to other ZIA endpoints)
findings.fix: A rule id reaches the path only as a positive whole number; anything else is reported and not sent

findings.title: Imported vendor regexes reached ZIA unvalidated (ReDoS shapes, invalid syntax, lookaround)
findings.fix: compile_export runs every dictionary through dictionary_limit_problems, which now parses each pattern and refuses nested unbounded repeats

findings.title: Pack dictionary patterns were never parsed or checked for catastrophic backtracking
findings.fix: New dlp_importer.pattern_problems (parse + nested-repeat check, PCRE-only escapes tolerated); all 270 shipped patterns pass

findings.title: Duplicate-id detection counted each id with list.count (quadratic): one duplicate in a large export pinned the CPU
findings.fix: collections.Counter in _finish and in the duplicate-decision check

findings.title: An unknown post mode was treated as update and wrote to the tenant
findings.fix: post_new_rule_order refuses any mode but auto/create/update before planning or writing

findings.title: Fetched rules kept the API's list order, so a backup posted back (undo) could restore a different order
findings.fix: fetch_current_rules returns rules sorted by ZIA order (stable; unnumbered last), non-objects dropped

findings.title: Delete-all returned no copy of the deleted rules, so the destructive step had no undo
findings.fix: The real run returns `backup` (every deleted rule, in order) that Step 5 create re-posts

findings.title: A failed enable left the setting at the last enum word tried
findings.fix: When a value was accepted but none verified, the object is PUT back exactly as read

findings.title: Enable wrote guessed keys onto settings objects and enum words into boolean fields
findings.fix: Only fields the endpoint carries are written, booleans only ever get True; documented /webDlpGlobalOptions tried first (SDK 1.11.3)

findings.title: Unknown cloud (tool argument or ZSCALER_CLOUD) silently signed in to the commercial cloud
findings.fix: refused before sign-in with zscaler_clouds.normalize

findings.title: A check that raised put its message unmasked into the MCP result
findings.fix: tenant_auth.mask_secrets on every exception detail

findings.title: Unauthenticated MCP server bound beyond loopback with a warning only
findings.fix: refused (exit 2) unless --allow-remote

findings.title: Console index cache: typed sign-ins of every tenant shared one bucket named like a valid profile id, and the latest-index lookup could answer for another tenant
findings.fix: bucket name no profile can take; cache_latest matches the tenant label and denies without profile or tenant

findings.title: GET /api/console-index/cached does not say which tenant the page is signed in to, so for typed sign-ins it can no longer return an index (fail closed) and for an edited profile it cannot check the tenant
findings.fix: GET /api/console-index/cached takes the page's sign-in (profile, or vanity domain and cloud; no secret) and passes its label to cache_latest; a gone profile or typed classic-API sign-in gets nothing; Find anything sends signInRef()

findings.title: discover_endpoints wrote the first item of every endpoint as values (a person's device on /zcc/devices) to a file anyone on the machine could read
findings.fix: field names and value types only, written owner-only

findings.title: native_zscaler kept the source tenant's dictionary id in an engine whose term was D{id}.U or D({id}), silently pointing at another dictionary in the target tenant
findings.fix: such an engine is left out with a warning

findings.title: Exponential ReDoS in the Terraform string token: an unterminated "$${$${... pins a worker thread
findings.fix: String token reduced to the equivalent unambiguous (\\.|[^"\\])*; the $${ / %%{ alternatives were subsumed and ambiguous

findings.title: Pack upload with a field of the wrong JSON type crashed validation (HTTP 500 on preview; ~1,500 fuzz-found inputs)
findings.fix: Shape check of every dictionary, engine, rule, sub-rule and app group in assemble_pack; refused in words

findings.title: Job log cursor stalled once the log reached MAX_LOG_LINES: every later line (Stop, the result) was lost to the poller
findings.fix: Job.dropped counts lines cut from the top; `next` and `since` count every line ever written

findings.title: Secrets written as key=value / "key": "value" were not masked in job logs (only token shapes were)
findings.fix: redact_line masks client secret, password, API key, private key and provisioning key pairs

findings.title: Retry-After / x-ratelimit-reset of inf or 1e12 became an unbounded hold of the whole run
findings.fix: A reset timer is trusted only when finite and at most 3600 s

findings.title: SDK exception text (which may echo the Authorization header) reached outcomes, results and records unredacted
findings.fix: tenant_auth.redact_tokens on the exception text in call()

findings.title: Ids from plans and records were put into raw request paths unchecked ('1/../../status' changes the endpoint of a DELETE/PUT/POST)
findings.fix: pc.path_id(): only a whole number goes into a raw path; otherwise nothing is sent

findings.title: is_enforcing() failed open: an unknown or lower-case action ("block", "QUARANTINE") was shipped as written instead of monitor-only
findings.fix: Deny by default: only the channel's monitor actions monitor; web payload guarded too

findings.title: An IPv4 a-b range compared with an IPv6 address raised TypeError: the analysis (and a Test a list run) failed for an IPv6 destination or source
findings.fix: Ranges compare only addresses of their own family (zia_path_modules._ip_rel, workload_path._ip_in)

findings.title: A firewall network-application rule was a definite no match on a port no service names (SSH on TCP/2222): a definite allow ZIA would not give
findings.fix: On an unnamed port a network application criterion is unknown (conditional), never no match

findings.title: A File Type Control rule for UPLOAD_DOWNLOAD did not apply to an upload or a download: a configured block reported as no rule
findings.fix: UPLOAD_DOWNLOAD applies to UPLOAD and DOWNLOAD (the value pack_channels validates)

findings.title: A connector rule restricted to destination workload groups (destWorkloadGroups) was evaluated as unrestricted: a definite DIRECT
findings.fix: destWorkloadGroups is a criterion not evaluated: the rule is conditional

findings.title: sourceIpGroupExclusion was ignored: a rule for sources outside its groups was applied to sources inside them
findings.fix: With sourceIpGroupExclusion the source must be outside every group (assumed from the SDK field); unknown members stay unknown

findings.title: A forwarding rule with method INVALID or an unknown one was reported as forwarded to ZIA (fail open)
findings.fix: An unknown forward method decides 'unknown' with an impact, never ZIA

findings.title: Test a list kept one answer per row: about 800 bytes a row, 201 MB for 250,000 rows
findings.fix: Rows with the same answer share one kept evaluation, without another row's headline (36 MB for 250,000 rows)

findings.title: A group- or user-scoped Client Connector app profile was taken as every user's (sample iOS profile is for Drivers): a definite path
findings.fix: A scoped profile ahead of the first unscoped one that treats the destination differently makes the path depend on the user (unverified), naming each profile

findings.title: App profiles sorted by ruleOrder as text ('10' before '9': wrong profile); mixed types and odd systemProxyData raised errors
findings.fix: ruleOrder is compared as a number (anything else sorts last); systemProxyData must be an object

findings.title: 5,000 firewall rules on shared groups took 3.4 s per analysis (indexes rebuilt and addresses re-parsed per rule)
findings.fix: Indexes built once per evaluation; address entries parsed once (bounded cache, long strings never cached): 0.7 s

findings.title: 5,000 connector forwarding rules on shared groups took 4 s (indexes, parses and lower-casing redone per rule)
findings.fix: Built once per evaluation: 0.6 s

findings.title: Test a list scanned every address entry for every row: 223 us a row against a 5,000-network group
findings.fix: The address space is split at every range end; a row is one bisect and each stretch's entries are worked out once (39 us a row); a property test checks it against a full scan

findings.title: A list port of '²' raised a bare ValueError (HTTP 500 with a trace); '٣' was taken as a port and as the PAC number 3
findings.fix: Every digit check is ASCII only

findings.title: A tenant list entry written in Unicode never matched its IDN destination (placed in punycode): a Block rule reported as not applying
findings.fix: Every list matcher (and Test a list's index) normalises entries with zia_path_modules.entry_host

findings.title: First-match shadow analysis compared every pair of rules (O(n²)): 3,000 firewall rules took 81 s
findings.fix: Per-criterion candidate index: each rule is compared only with rules that can cover it; same findings as all pairs

findings.title: An assessment score drop was re-reported (and re-sent) every other loop run
findings.fix: Digests carry the drops already reported forward (bounded to 20 per tenant)

findings.title: A negated posture condition kept its operator when deciding whether posture is optional (DP-04 false positive / miss, wrong enforced count)
findings.fix: De Morgan: a negated condition flips AND/OR, as the plain sentence already did

findings.title: Error text hid a token value before PEM blocks, so a certificate body after a token leaked into results
findings.fix: PEM blocks are hidden first

findings.title: Audit times with a zone abbreviation (PDT, CEST) were read as UTC, hours off, breaking the 15-minute own-write correlation
findings.fix: Table of unambiguous abbreviations; ambiguous or unknown zones are unreadable, never guessed

findings.title: Tenant errors in the digest (connect, reads) were not scrubbed of the profile's own client secret, password or API key
findings.fix: Every tenant error is scrubbed of the profile's secrets in all encodings, failing closed

findings.title: channel_coverage counts from the request that are not numbers made /api/posture/analyze and /summary answer 500; a damaged settings file or history state also raised
findings.fix: Counts, settings and states are read defensively

findings.title: Markdown exports: a tenant value starting with '# ', '- ', '1. ' or '---' became a heading, list item or rule (also inside a '- {name}' bullet)
findings.fix: md_safe.text escapes a leading block marker

findings.title: Word report: posted metadata that is not text (a number, list or object), a check without status or a null detail made /api/report/docx fail with a 500
findings.fix: Normalise every posted check field and metadata value to text

findings.title: POV: a page could set or change who wrote a note and when by re-sending a stored note id with another author
findings.fix: Note author and time are set by the app: kept when unchanged, the editor's when edited

findings.title: POV import: created_at was any text, so a file could set a future start and hide every change made during the POV from the customer report
findings.fix: An imported start must be a real past time; stored in UTC

findings.title: Snapshots kept Client Connector OTPs and stored credentials (deviceOtpArray, exitOtp, uninstallOtp, zpaDisableOtp, credJson, tempAuthCode, keyValue, apiCredentials, provisionKey) in the saved file
findings.fix: scrub masks every OTP and stored-credential field name the SDK models use, any value type

findings.title: Another localhost app's malformed cookie made the server ignore the sample/snapshot choice and put the browser back on the live tenant
findings.fix: the offline cookie is read pair by pair (RFC 6265) instead of SimpleCookie, which drops every cookie after one it cannot parse

findings.title: Readiness never found the API client's ZPA role: the SDK hands list_roles' body as a {list: [...]} envelope, so view-only ZPA classes were missed and segment moves judged on the role name alone
findings.fix: _find_by reads the ZPA envelope's list (bounded)

findings.title: Traffic flow (data_flow.py) reads only older app-profile names: on an API-shaped profile it shows Endpoint DLP and the SSL certificate as off and drops the comma-separated destination exclusions and custom app bypasses (exposed by the corrected sample)
findings.fix: data_flow reads enableZdpService, install_ssl_certs/installCerts and bypassCustomAppIds first (SDK 1.11.3 zcc/models/webpolicy.py), older names after; destination exclusions were already read as tunnel.exclude, so not duplicated

findings.title: Log evidence redaction missed bearer tokens, JSON-quoted keys, prefixed *_token / JSESSIONID / provisioning_key keys and all but the first cookie
findings.fix: Header-aware (Authorization, Cookie) and key-suffix redaction, quoted keys and values, bounded linear patterns

findings.title: Detection Health threshold overrides were not validated: a text threshold was a 500 and telemetry_patterns compiled a request-written regular expression
findings.fix: clean_settings: bounded whole numbers, short text lists, plain-text telemetry fragments; invalid values keep the default with a note

findings.title: fp/dead/promote windows longer than the incidents read: 7 days of incidents raised 'Disable X: no incident in 30 days'
findings.fix: Each window is clamped to the days read and the report states the windows used

findings.title: An incident read stopped at MAX_PAGES was silent, so counts and dead rules were built on part of the window
findings.fix: Truncation is a read problem and no rule is called dead

findings.title: A Web DLP rule that forwards no match to an Incident Receiver (it can never have an incident) was called dead and given a retire proposal
findings.fix: Such rules are not_measured, with no dead-rule finding or proposal

findings.title: Bypass Markdown export wrote tenant category names, rule names, URLs and keywords raw in the URL Category Expansion Detail (forged heading, link, code-span break-out)
findings.fix: md_safe.text / md_safe.code for every tenant value in that section

findings.title: A rule list or advanced settings answering 401/403/5xx was reported as zero bypasses (fail-open reporting)
findings.fix: Unreadable sections are a diagnostic and status unverified; 404 stays 'not on this tenant'; ZCC with no endpoint answering is a diagnostic

findings.title: Detection Health read problems (SDK error text) went into the report and the live feed with no scrub
findings.fix: generate() and poll_incidents() take a scrub applied to every read problem

findings.title: The /api/detection-health and live-feed routes do not mask the sign-in's secrets in the read problems they return
findings.fix: /api/detection-health and /api/live-feed pass detection_health's scrub hook (tenant_auth.mask_secrets with the sign-in); the report's log lines and proposal error are masked too (test isolation follow-up a730f83)

findings.title: The Log Analyzer page's Markdown download builds from raw upload text: file and PAC names, users, notes and bypass values add headings, links or table cells, and a log line holding ``` closes the evidence fence
findings.fix: report_logs.html escapes every upload-derived value as md_safe.text does and fences evidence longer than any backtick run it holds; tests run the page's own markdown() in Node. Also ...::test_the_log_analyzer_markdown_evidence_fence_cannot_be_closed_by_a_log_line

findings.title: Bypass report wrote tenant rule ids and counts into HTML unescaped (a crafted snapshot ran script)
findings.fix: Escape every id and count; also cap the aggregated lists at 500 rows and 6 references

findings.title: update() raised on a git pull timeout or when git vanished mid-update, so POST /api/app/update answered 500
findings.fix: update() wraps the run; a pull timeout is a step error and set-aside edits are re-applied

findings.title: local_settings.bat, which receives ZSCALER_CLIENT_SECRET when settings are moved out of a start script, was created with the umask (0644)
findings.fix: written through safe_files.private_open (0600, an existing file narrowed)

findings.title: The POSIX relauncher put the app folder into sh -c script text, so a folder named with $( ), ` or a quote ran commands on restart
findings.fix: each path is escaped for sh double quotes (_sh_dq: backslash, ", $ and `)

findings.title: _safe_get() read every answer whole into memory with no size cap
findings.fix: streamed and capped at MAX_BODY_BYTES (64 MB); a larger or larger-declared body is refused

findings.title: The update check's network diagnostics and fetch errors echoed proxy URLs with user:password (HTTPS_PROXY, http_proxy, ZSCALER_UPDATE_PROXY)
findings.fix: redact_url_credentials() on every proxy value and error message

findings.title: An existing per-user data folder (an older version's, or the old name moved into place) kept 0755; in the standalone edition it holds the UI token, profiles and the audit log
findings.fix: data_dir() narrows an owned, non-link folder to 0700

findings.title: download_sdk() used a version string from PyPI's answer as a URL segment and as the extraction folder (../ escaped the work folder)
findings.fix: valid_version() (PEP 440 characters only) before any request or path; malformed release keys ignored

findings.title: Install command left values with PowerShell/cmd metacharacters unquoted, and typographic quotes closed PowerShell strings
findings.fix: Quote every Windows value outside a bare-safe set; refuse U+2018-U+201F, control/format/separator characters and non-text values.

findings.title: A framework or captured rule that names nothing to match was created as a match-all rule
findings.fix: fit() drops any non-catch-all rule with no match field (MATCH_FIELDS per area), with the reason

findings.title: AI Guard routing and detection policy applied live (enabled) changes without the typed phrase when 10 or fewer
findings.fix: both builders set confirm_always (APPLY n CHANGES) for every plan with a change, Undo included

findings.title: A Sandbox rule re-read through the SDK 1.11.3 model lost its isolation profile: updates stripped it, read-back was a false mismatch
findings.fix: get_one merges every field the model leaves out from the raw answer, as list reads do

findings.title: Other Bulk changes operations re-read rules with admin_ops._one, which drops fields the SDK model lacks (sandbox cbiProfile) before a PUT
findings.fix: Already fixed on integrate/w6: admin_ops._one now returns pack_export.one_row(ret), which backfills the raw answer's fields the SDK model drops (sandbox cbiProfile); no change needed

findings.title: ZPA reader stopped at a short page even when totalPages said more, and trusted the SDK's default totalPages=1: large tenants silently truncated
findings.fix: The page body's totalPages decides; only when no total is stated does a short page end the list; an empty page always ends it.

findings.title: ZPA builder planned from a list cut at the page limit (duplicates created, objects to delete missed)
findings.fix: An incomplete list is a read error: the plan is refused.

findings.title: ZPA reader and builder called ZPA with an SDK client whose customer ID was missing or invalid (/customers/None/...)
findings.fix: customer_id_problem() refuses a missing or non-alphanumeric (>64) customer ID before any ZPA call.

findings.title: Bulk changes routes for ZPA builder types do not check the OneAPI sign-in and customer ID before signing in
findings.fix: _ops_zpa_gate (400 before sign-in for a classic-API sign-in or a missing/invalid customer ID) on the six /api/operations routes and the Undo preview; admin_ops.product_of names a type's product; the ops request models take the customer_id the page already sent (it was dropped)

findings.title: SDK error text could carry a provisioning key value into logs and results (only bearer/token/secret/password were redacted)
findings.fix: Provisioning-key shaped values and provisioningKey/api_key fields are replaced by [hidden]; the text is cut before redaction.

findings.title: ZPA builder accepted 0.0.0.0/0, ::/0 and /8 subnets from a CSV: segments its own analysis reports as over-broad (high)
findings.fix: Subnets wider than IPv4 /9 or IPv6 /33 are refused with their size.

findings.title: A single-object re-read (admin_ops._one, the read before every Build new and Bulk changes update and the read-back) dropped fields SDK 1.11.3's model leaves out: a ZIA baseline re-run that updated a sandbox rule sent it back without its isolation profile (PUT replaces the rule), and every first build with an isolation profile was reported 'partial' with a false read-back mismatch
findings.fix: pack_export.one_row fills what the model omits from the raw answer, as the list reader already did; admin_ops._one uses it

findings.title: Applying a proposal (and self-healing's Heal) to an Email DLP rule sent the rule back without zscalerIncidentReceiver and rank (not in the SDK model) and with the model's padding inside the engine references: incident forwarding was silently turned off while the change read back as verified
findings.fix: proposal_apply reads rules through pack_export._rows (raw fields and references kept) before writing them back whole

findings.title: Bulk changes: moving a segment's only domain was previewed as a move but, at apply time, the removal was excluded (ZPA keeps one domain per segment) after the addition was written, so the move became a copy reported 'partial'; a clone-and-move created a new segment with no domain at all
findings.fix: the plan excludes a removal that would empty a segment with that reason, excludes its paired addition and every step that waits for an excluded one; the clone handler never creates an empty segment

findings.title: Undo of a pack deployment deleted what it created but left the confidence a tweak had changed on an existing tenant dictionary, and still reported 'undone' and complete
findings.fix: the deploy records each tweak's before and after; Undo puts the confidence back while the dictionary still holds the tweaked value (else skips and says why), then activates

findings.title: A network service UDP_ANY or ICMP_ANY on a rule was 'unknown' for TCP traffic, making the firewall answer falsely conditional
findings.fix: A protocol-wide service of another protocol is a definite no match

findings.title: A URL or DLP rule limited to a user risk score was treated as applying to everyone: a definite 'Blocked' headline under a conditional certainty
findings.fix: userRiskScoreLevels is scope in the trace and an open what-if dimension

findings.title: A URL filtering rule's validity period (enforceTimeValidity) was ignored: a block outside its period was reported as definite
findings.fix: An enforced validity period is a condition named with its dates

findings.title: A scoped SSL or URL rule with the same action ahead of the deciding rule made the answer conditional
findings.fix: Only a scoped rule that would act differently makes the answer conditional

findings.title: A bare custom URL category entry (example.com) placed its subdomains in the category, and a path entry placed every path
findings.fix: Category placement uses ZIA's URL list semantics (zia_path_modules.url_hit), path entries only for that path

findings.title: Internationalised host names (IDN) were refused by the Path analyzer, Test a list and ZPA diagnostics
findings.fix: IDN hosts are converted to punycode (UTS 46) as ZIA, ZPA and DNS hold them

findings.title: A password typed in a URL (https://user:pass@host/) was repeated in the result and in error messages
findings.fix: User info is left out of the echoed input and every message

findings.title: The PAC file was evaluated against the full https:// URL (browsers strip it to scheme, host and port) and against https:// for plain-HTTP traffic
findings.fix: path_analyzer.pac_url gives the URL a browser passes; Test a list uses the same one

findings.title: A conditional SSL rule after a definite firewall, ATP or DNS block still made the answer conditional; non-web or bypassed traffic stayed 'policy conditional' on web rules it never meets
findings.fix: SSL is not reached after a definite stop; policy_conditional is recomputed from the hops as they stand

findings.title: ZPA diagnostics said 'Depends on the user' when every possible answer is deny, and 'unless' an earlier rule with the same action
findings.fix: Only an earlier rule that would allow where the rest deny (or the reverse) makes it conditional

findings.title: Test a list shared one answer between rows that must differ: list entries with a trailing dot, an IPv4 and an IPv6 row, PAC answers for http:// rows
findings.fix: The sharing fingerprint strips trailing dots, includes the address family and evaluates the PAC for the row's own URL

findings.title: Which rule applies ignored ZIA admin ranking: rules were taken by order alone even with Admin Ranking on
findings.fix: admin_rank orders ranked policies by admin rank, then order, when the setting is on; unknown or not in scope is cautioned, never guessed

findings.title: Log analyzer: a PAC the new evaluator refuses (regular expression, array, loop, switch) lost its whole reading (default, gateways, bypass inventory, fail-open/closed, hard-coded gateway), including a reference-style PAC
findings.fix: log_analyzer reads such a PAC from its text again (never run, bounded to pac_eval.MAX_SOURCE) and still says it was not evaluated

findings.title: The change queue's fix-recipe path (file, then apply) skipped the Scope check the direct remediation route enforces, so an approved fix could read and write a rule policy not in scope
findings.fix: One helper (_require_recipe_in_scope) on the direct route, on /api/change-queue/recipe and on apply of a fix_recipe, before sign-in; the request models take the optional Scope fields and both pages send them

findings.title: Deployment Undo PUT dictionary confidence outside the per-tenant write lock and before the busy check, then reported that nothing was read or written
findings.fix: pack_deploy.undo holds ops.tenant_run for the tweak PUTs (rate limits, run control, audited run) and the removal (remove_deployment tenant_held, _execute_locked); busy is refused and audited

findings.title: Esc that closed a help pop-up also cancelled the typed-confirmation dialog or closed Find anything, and focus in those fields opened the pop-up over the dialog's buttons and the result list
findings.fix: static/hover_help.js: an Esc that closes the pop-up is consumed (preventDefault, stopImmediatePropagation); a text field in an open dialog or a combobox opens it on hover only

findings.title: The committed docs/QUALITY_SCORE.md and docs/quality_score.json were stale (a fixed high still capped the score at 69), so --check failed on a clean checkout
findings.fix: Both outputs regenerated and committed after the record changes

findings.title: The API access page (reachable without the UI token) showed the latest readiness answers: tenant name, API role, licences and what works
findings.fix: /permissions renders the live part only for a caller who passes security.ui_request_ok, no-store when it does

findings.title: A saved or opened snapshot kept the values of policyToken, deviceToken, machineToken, authenticationToken and provisioningKey fields
findings.fix: offline_tenant.scrub masks text values under token and key names (true/false switches stay)

findings.title: An API error page that repeats the Authorization header put the OneAPI access token into Path analyzer and Test a list job logs, results and exports, POV evidence and the install command builder's answer
findings.fix: The raw client masks every error text it returns (secrets and its own token); tenant_auth.mask_secrets and SDK error texts redact bearer tokens, JWTs and session ids by shape

findings.title: A PAC hex literal past 2^1024 raised OverflowError out of pac_eval.evaluate() and inspect() (tenant PAC read, log upload, Test a list); other parse errors were not failed closed
findings.fix: hex literals read as Infinity like JavaScript; compile_pac turns any unexpected parse error into 'could not evaluate safely'

findings.title: An imported POV file with NaN was stored and made the import and every later open of that profile's POV a 500
findings.fix: POV import reads strict JSON; Insights counts kept only when finite

findings.title: ZIA framework files were not type-checked: fields of the wrong type made the Bulk changes preview a 500, non-string names were coerced, and names with right-to-left overrides or zero-width characters were written to the tenant as rule names
findings.fix: load_framework denies by default: name and title text, fields an object, format_version an integer, no bidirectional / invisible / control character in a name

findings.title: A framework rule title (or a captured rule description) was cut one character at a time with a re-encode each step: quadratic, minutes of CPU for a 1 MB title
findings.fix: _fit_bytes cuts to the byte limit in characters first, then trims

findings.title: Undo applied any operation under undo_of: it marked the recorded operation undone without applying its inverse, and an already undone operation was signed in to again
findings.fix: _ops_apply_gate requires the recorded inverse exactly and refuses an operation already undone (409) before sign-in

findings.title: Undo-only forms (url_categories / zpa_domains / zia_baseline revert, AI Guard undo, ZPA undo) were accepted as ordinary operations, so an apply could delete objects the app never created (a customer's ZPA segment was deleted)
findings.fix: admin_ops.is_undo_only: such a form is applied only with undo_of naming its recorded operation (409 otherwise, before sign-in)

findings.title: Two applies of the same plan at once both passed the plan hash and the re-read and both sent the create
findings.fix: pack_ops.tenant_run: one write run per tenant (deploy, removal, undo, bulk change, build); a second is refused busy with nothing read or written, audited, and a queued request stays approved

findings.title: The shared write path re-sent a create answered by a timeout or 5xx, which may have been applied, for every object kind (duplicates)
findings.fix: pack_ops.call resends a maybe-applied create only after a read by name shows it absent (name_check for pack kinds), else reports it not resent; a found object is reused

findings.title: The raw HTTP client (remediation, migration wizard) re-sent a POST after a read timeout, a reset connection or a 502/504
findings.fix: Client._write does not resend such a POST and says so; connection never made, 429/503 and idempotent PUT/DELETE retry as before

findings.title: The migration wizard's live delete-all and post had no plan hash: delete-all deleted rules added after its dry run, post overwrote rules edited since
findings.fix: dry runs return a plan hash over the tenant's rules (and the proposal); live runs require it (400 before sign-in) and give plan_changed when the tenant moved; the page sends it

findings.title: With the sample tenant open, Run assessment on the Scope page asked for a vanity domain, client ID and secret and sent the user back to Connect: the sample could not be assessed from the sidebar
findings.fix: static/dashboard.js: the sample tenant or an opened snapshot needs no sign-in fields and counts as signed in (the rule missingSignInFields already had)

findings.title: The bundled reference pages failed text contrast: 268 elements on first view (light scheme) across the three framework pages, the Framework Machine and the Data Security Architect, as low as 1.98:1, more on the other tabs
findings.fix: static/reference/reference_a11y.js, served with every reference page, moves each failing colour's lightness (same hue) until it reaches AA, measured at rest

findings.title: Reference pages were not keyboard operable in places: the channel toggles and stat cards were mouse-only (the portfolio matrix stayed dimmed for keyboard users) and 24 scrolling regions (the architect timelines, the framework figure, the playbook) could not be reached
findings.fix: the layer makes click-only elements buttons (Enter, Space, aria-pressed, focus kept after a redraw) and scrolling regions focusable and named

findings.title: Four-eyes compared people with lower() only: full-width / compatibility spellings of the requester's name passed
findings.fix: Compare NFKC-normalised, case-folded identities

findings.title: Approval not bound to what was approved, and a finished request could be finished again (re-marked failed/applied)
findings.fix: Store approved_digest (kind, tenant, plan_hash, payload) and check it in begin_apply; finish_apply only ends a claimed approved request

findings.title: Queue steps (decide, comment, withdraw, apply) accepted an empty actor
findings.fix: Every step needs a named actor (401)

findings.title: proposals.json was written through a fixed temporary file (the store's name plus .tmp) opened with open() (follows a planted symlink, umask permissions until chmod, no cross-process lock)
findings.fix: <store>.tmp (git-ignored) created afresh with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW at 0600 after removing any leftover or link, fsync, atomic replace, under flock on <store>.lock

findings.title: Snooze days were unbounded: a huge value raised OverflowError (500)
findings.fix: Clamp to 1..365 and refuse non-numbers in plain words

findings.title: A wrongly shaped operation (targets / order / deltas not a list of objects) crashed plan() with TypeError / AttributeError: a 500 on /api/operations/preview
findings.fix: _list_field() validates shape; require_scope tolerates a non-list

findings.title: Undo (revert) specs skipped MAX_URLS / MAX_DOMAINS, and invalid entries were uncapped (one excluded item each)
findings.fix: Caps on revert totals, deltas and deletes, and on raw entries

findings.title: Custom URLs accepted control characters in the path; IDN hosts were refused instead of sent as punycode
findings.fix: Refuse C0/C1 control characters; encode IDN hosts with the idna codec (assumed: ZIA and ZPA store punycode)

findings.title: Fix recipe: an omitted optional number (rank) crashed plan() with TypeError (500)
findings.fix: Field defaults are filled before validation; a missing integer is a validation error

findings.title: Fix recipe: dicts, lists, booleans and fractions were copied into the API body as given; free text without max_length was uncapped
findings.fix: Single values only, bool is not a number, MAX_TEXT default cap

findings.title: Plugin registry accepted non-callable hooks, bad handler or product names, type == family, and let a later registration replace a type's planner or a family's scope gate
findings.fix: register() validates every hook and name and refuses a takeover

findings.title: A plan whose write group named an unknown handler raised KeyError in the middle of a run (after earlier writes)
findings.fix: _finish refuses the plan before anything is written

findings.title: Names of created URL categories and cloned ZPA segments accepted control characters and were silently cut at 255; super_category was free text
findings.fix: _object_name() and a ZIA super-category pattern (SDK 1.11.3 example BUSINESS_AND_ECONOMY)

findings.title: Fix recipe: the URL category id list was unchecked
findings.fix: Up to 256 plain ids

findings.title: /api/remediation/execute has no Scope check: a live fix writes (and, for RULE-DESC, now reads the rule) whatever the Scope page ticks
findings.fix: A live fix maps its recipe (RULE-DESC by rule_type) to a rule policy and refuses one not in scope, 400 before sign-in; unknown policy denied; dry runs unchanged. The same check covers a fix filed in and applied from the change queue (REVIEW-BACKEND-01)

findings.title: Non-JSON NaN/Infinity literals in a body reached handlers (int(NaN) in the HAR batch was a 500)
findings.fix: Every route decodes bodies as strict RFC 8259 JSON (_StrictJSONRoute); NaN/Infinity is a 422/400 before any handler

findings.title: 500, 429 and CORS preflight answers carried no CSP, nosniff or frame denial
findings.fix: SecurityHeadersMiddleware sits just inside the body cap (outside the rate limiter, CORS and the UI token gate); the unhandled-error 500 sets the same headers itself (commits cb3d1b3 and d1fc71f)

findings.title: /api/live-feed trusted the page's running tally: a missing or non-numeric counter was a KeyError/TypeError 500, extra keys were echoed back
findings.fix: _live_tally keeps the known counters as bounded whole numbers and drops everything else

findings.title: Under SSO, any signed-in person could stop another person's running deploy or removal by job id
findings.fix: _require_job_owner: a job with a known starter is stopped only by that person (no change without SSO)

findings.title: 5xx details quoting an exception named absolute server folders (app, Python, temp, home)
findings.fix: The HTTPException handler names each server folder by its role in every 5xx detail

findings.title: HAR batch: schemes/methods that are not lists were a TypeError 500, and methods "GET" was read as G, E, T
findings.fix: Only lists are read (at most 100 items); anything else names no method or scheme

findings.title: /api/migrate/optimize, /upload and /post passed rule rows unchecked: a non-text name, state or action was an AttributeError 500
findings.fix: _rule_text_fields (shared with the hand-read routes' _rule_rows) refuses with a 400 naming the field before sign-in

findings.title: Evaluate All optimiser exceptions of the wrong shape (pinned list, text position, numeric skip list) were 500s
findings.fix: _eval_all_exceptions checks audit_only_actions, pinned and skip_rule_ids (400)

findings.title: /api/posture/analyze and /project: a check row's section or channel that was a list or object was an unhashable TypeError 500
findings.fix: _posture_checks reads sec, section and channel as bounded text and out_of_scope as a boolean

findings.title: /api/migrate/reorder: a list or object order token, or a rule named by a list, was an unhashable TypeError 500
findings.fix: Order tokens must be text or numbers and rule names text (400)

findings.title: path_analyzer.parse_destination rejects a bare IPv6 literal (2001:db8::1, ::1): one IPv6 row (bracketed or a v6 CIDR, which bulk_test expands to bare addresses) fails the whole Test a list job, a bare IPv6 HAR host is skipped and the single analyzer answers 400
