findings.title: The rbac Scope page key had no Required API access card, and refused RBAC checks were counted under zia_extras, zcc, zpa or zidentity, so the RBAC permissions were never listed
findings.fix: rbac added to SCOPE_PERMISSIONS; every RBAC section maps to rbac

findings.title: Sample tenant shapes differed from the API (ZDX camelCase, invented company-info and app-profile fields, Evaluate All Rules under advancedSettings, endpoint/email receivers, file-type classes) and it lacked answers the checks and pages read (14 Cloud App Control types, DLP global options, privacy, cleanup, admin sync, ZDX alerts and inventory, Path analyzer ZIA reads, ZPA roles and profiles)
findings.fix: sample data re-shaped from SDK 1.11.3 models; every SDK-documented read a check or page makes has an answer

findings.title: The offline platform filter ignored device_type (the API's app-profile field), so a per-platform read returned every platform's profiles
findings.fix: answer_get filters on device_type or deviceType

findings.title: A saved snapshot dropped the channel declaration it was saved with (_clean_meta rejected channel_scope.normalize's dicts)
findings.fix: _clean_meta keeps each channel's choice from a normalized declaration

findings.title: Sample writes aliased the caller's payload: changing a posted or updated dict later changed the in-memory tenant
findings.fix: POST and PUT deep-copy the body

findings.title: Copying the channel guard (channel_scope.ScopedClient) recursed until RecursionError (__getattr__ before __init__)
findings.fix: __getattr__ answers AttributeError for _client and dunder names

findings.title: A request could rename a fixed Scope page channel, and that name appeared in the report and page notes
findings.fix: a Scope page channel always carries its canonical name; custom channels keep theirs, bounded

findings.title: ZCC company-info check (zscaler_full_checks.zcc_5) reads companyName, which getCompanyInfo does not send (businessName), so it always says 'Company: ?'
findings.fix: zcc_5 reads businessName first (SDK 1.11.3 zcc/models/company_info.py), then companyName and name

findings.title: _scope_selection and _beacon_scope drop a non-empty channel declaration whose entries cannot be read, so it narrows nothing instead of making every channel a gap (channel_scope.effective's rule)
findings.fix: _channel_declaration: any non-empty channels object is the page's declaration (every channel a gap when unreadable), so the saved profile is never read instead

findings.title: No control explained what it does or what input it expects on hover or focus (the owner's request)
findings.fix: Shared Help on hover engine and a catalogue entry for every control on every page and the extension

findings.title: Native title tooltips (about 150 controls) did not open on keyboard focus or touch and could not be dismissed with Esc
findings.fix: Titles converted into catalogue entries word for word; the engine removes the native title so one pop-up shows

findings.title: /help scrolls sideways at 320 px: the .xp-dl grid's 1fr column takes its longest word's width (362 px page)
findings.fix: Resolved at integration (UI check, 40f879c): minmax(0, 1fr) column and overflow-wrap on /help; checked: the test fails at /help 320px with that CSS reverted

findings.title: /report/fleet scrolls sideways at 320 px: installer option labels are inline-flex rows that never wrap (343 px page)
findings.fix: Resolved at integration (UI ops, de7653a): installer labels wrap and shrink; browser check: 320 px page with the options of both platforms drawn

findings.title: The shared browser-test harness (test_findings_reflow.run_in_browser) leaves the in-app updater and restart live: a test that clicks Update now runs git against the developer's checkout (seen in this QA: a crawl switched the clone to main and stashed local edits)
findings.fix: run_in_browser replaces app_update.update and schedule_restart for the served app, so a toured Update now or Restart never touches the checkout

findings.title: A ZIP with thousands of entries past the member cap returned one note per entry (unbounded response)
findings.fix: Stop at the member cap and keep at most MAX_NOTES notes plus a count

findings.title: The not_real override was echoed in the report but verdicts were always taken with the defaults
findings.fix: Verdicts re-derived with the run's not_real list

findings.title: Summary users / destinations counted the '(unknown ...)' placeholder rows
findings.fix: Count distinct known users and destinations only

findings.title: A boolean advanced setting whose key holds 'bypass' (enableEvaluatePolicyOnGlobalSSLBypass) was counted as an SSL exemption and as a bypassed URL 'False'
findings.fix: Only lists and non-empty texts are exempted values

findings.title: Bypass rules scoped by SDK conditions (locationGroups, sourceIpGroups, deviceGroups, platforms, timeWindows, ...) were flagged 'applies to everyone'
findings.fix: The scope summary reads every scope field the SDK models carry (as_dict camelCase)

findings.title: SSL flow sort crashed on a rule id or order sent as text or an infinity
findings.fix: _int() with a default for ids and orders

findings.title: SSL coverage counted a boolean protocol total as 1 and did not total the unrecognised protocols apart
findings.fix: Booleans skipped; unrecognised_total added (names still listed, never bucketed)

findings.title: Insights validate_window raised OverflowError (not WindowError) for an infinite bound
findings.fix: OverflowError refused as a WindowError

findings.title: Log Analyzer kept the first 400 tunnel states, so a long log reported a stale last tunnel state
findings.fix: deque of the latest 400

findings.title: A PAC with a low finding was summed up as 'passes every check'
findings.fix: Low PAC findings give an 'info' verdict

findings.title: Live feed 'since' without a zone was a TypeError (500); one in the future asked an inverted window
findings.fix: Naive is UTC; a future cursor starts now

findings.title: A .gz with a good header and a broken deflate body raised zlib.error out of analyze() (500)
findings.fix: zlib.error is a note

findings.title: A ZIP claiming a future version raised NotImplementedError (500); a lying member offset failed the whole upload with 'negative seek value'
findings.fix: Both are notes for that archive or member; seeded mutation test

findings.title: Malformed tenant data stopped reports: a bare category name read character by character, int() of text match counts, out-of-range createdAt, non-list fields, a list rule id, ZCC shapes
findings.fix: Defensive readers (_names, _whole, _items, _seq/_map); 400-case seeded test

findings.title: safe_files.zip_member lets ValueError ('negative seek value') and OSError escape for a member whose offset lies, so callers that catch only ArchiveRefused fail
findings.fix: zip_member refuses ValueError and OSError from a lying member offset as ArchiveRefused (ArchiveRefused itself re-raised first)

findings.title: clean_settings (added in this wave) raised OverflowError on an Infinity threshold
findings.fix: math.isfinite check

findings.title: A second renderPermissions() on the main page silently replaced the partial-scan one: after a run the card that says how many checks could not run never showed
findings.fix: static/index.html: the card's function is renamed renderPartialScan; a test fails when two main-page scripts declare one global function

findings.title: Results restored from sessionStorage were drawn into the tiles and section bars without being coerced to numbers (markup from stored state)
findings.fix: static/index.html: restored counts are coerced to numbers before they are drawn

findings.title: Custom channels read from localStorage kept their stored icon unescaped, and a null entry crashed the dashboard
findings.fix: static/dashboard.js: a custom channel is rebuilt from {id: custom_*, name}; the icon is the fixed one and the name is escaped

findings.title: The guide's Last deployment line printed a stored count as markup
findings.fix: static/guide.js: the last deployment's count is a number, never stored markup

findings.title: An unknown channel name in a stored deployment record was not escaped in Previous deployments, and a malformed channel list threw
findings.fix: static/deploy_studio.js: an unknown channel name is escaped; a malformed channel list is skipped

findings.title: Save config threw when site storage was blocked, and Clear config left the fields filled
findings.fix: static/index.html: Save config reports blocked storage in words; Clear config still clears the fields

findings.title: The SSO bar used the sign-in and sign-out addresses from the status answer as they came, so another site or a javascript: URL could become the link
findings.fix: static/ui_auth.js: only a same-origin path is used; anything else falls back to the fixed path (deny by default)

findings.title: A browser that refuses alert, confirm or prompt made the button that asked throw and stop working
findings.fix: static/ui_auth.js: a refused box reads as no (fail closed) and the app's own dialog shows its text

findings.title: The Terraform hand-off dialog dropped keyboard focus to the page behind it whenever it redrew its body (packs loaded, a pack ticked with Space, the mode changed)
findings.fix: static/deploy_studio.js: _tfRender puts focus back on the same control after it rebuilds the body, or on the dialog's Close button when that control is gone

findings.title: Bulk changes Apply was enabled before the typed phrase, the review box or the assessor were given, and the page's phrase check (toUpperCase) accepted look-alikes the server refuses
findings.fix: Apply is disabled until every gate is met; phraseMatches mirrors security.typed_phrase_matches; the phrase is shown in bold

findings.title: A window focus redrew the Bulk changes apply form, erasing the typed phrase, the review tick and the keyboard focus
findings.fix: Redraw only when write mode changed; a redraw of the same plan keeps the phrase, the box and the focus

findings.title: Bypass report drew every aggregated item (tens of thousands after category expansion) in one innerHTML write
findings.fix: Draw the first 500 rows with 6 references each and say how many more the export has

findings.title: Client Connector fleet page scrolled sideways at 320px (install builder fields), failing the existing reflow test on this branch
findings.fix: Install builder labels wrap and inputs shrink to the line

findings.title: Error details from FastAPI (a 422 list or an object) showed as '[object Object]' on 11 owned pages
findings.fix: A per-page errText helper words string, {cause} and list details

findings.title: Extension accepted an https or [::1] app address that its CSP connect-src and host_permissions block, so the setting saved and never answered
findings.fix: normalizeAppUrl accepts only http on 127.0.0.1 or localhost, the origins the manifest allows

findings.title: ZPA connector group form sent 5 when the enrollment count was typed as 0 (Number(x) || 5), hiding the user's value
findings.fix: Send a whole number as typed and anything else as text, so the server refuses it in words; blank stays 5

findings.title: HAR parser kept every distinct host and listed every host over the cap, so a capture with hundreds of thousands of hosts filled memory and the DOM; a huge bodySize made the sums Infinity
findings.fix: Track at most 20000 hosts (count the rest), list at most 1000 left out with more_total, cap a body at the file size

findings.title: Keyboard focus fell to the page after Apply and after Undo (their buttons are removed)
findings.fix: Focus the outcome card after Apply and the plan heading after Undo

findings.title: Beacon links from watched pages and the run history were linked whatever their scheme
findings.fix: safeHref links only https addresses (also on the POV kit links)

findings.title: Detection health's stricter-for-users approval showed its phrase only as a placeholder and left Approve enabled
findings.fix: The phrase is a visible label; Approve is disabled until the exact phrase is typed

findings.title: Install command builder kept offering Copy and Download of the last command after the form changed
findings.fix: A change to the form withdraws the command until it is built again

findings.title: Extension pages' CSP had no default-src, so images, styles, frames and form targets were not restricted
findings.fix: default-src 'self' and form-action 'none'; the options page's inline style moved to options.css

findings.title: github_branch_head() raised on a GitHub answer that was not JSON or not an object, returned a non-hex 'sha', and put an unvalidated branch into the URL
findings.fix: branch checked with valid_branch(); the sha must be hex; any bad answer is (None, reason)

findings.title: verify_against_github_api() raised on a non-string sha and matched an empty local commit as verified
findings.fix: sha parsed by _api_sha(); an empty local commit never matches (fail closed)

findings.title: recover_unmerged() read conflicted paths without -z, so a non-ASCII file name came back quoted, was not copied aside, and was reset
findings.fix: git diff --name-only -z

findings.title: git error text shown in update results could quote a credentialed remote URL (older git)
findings.fix: _err() redacts URL user-info

findings.title: An update cache that was not a JSON object (or had a non-object entry) turned every source into an internal error
findings.fix: _load_cache() keeps only object entries

findings.title: _check_pypi() raised on a PyPI answer in the wrong shape
findings.fix: shape checked; status error with plain words

findings.title: download_sdk() unpacked a wheel with no cap on members or unpacked size
findings.fix: MAX_WHEEL_MEMBERS and MAX_WHEEL_UNPACKED checked before extractall

findings.title: pypi_releases(), registry_latest() and download_sdk() raised on JSON of another shape, deep nesting or a damaged wheel
findings.fix: shape checks; (None, reason) results

findings.title: The standalone edition crashed at start with a traceback on a local_settings.env that is not UTF-8 (UTF-16 from Notepad) and glued a UTF-8 BOM to the first key
findings.fix: read as utf-8-sig; a file that is not text is skipped

findings.title: check_locks() cleared a stale owner note by truncating the file by name after the check, erasing the note of a run that took the lock in between
findings.fix: _clear_owner_note_if_free() truncates only while holding the flock

findings.title: ZDX custom app URL accepted loopback, link-local (cloud metadata), unspecified, multicast and reserved addresses and numeric-tail hosts
findings.fix: clean_url refuses those addresses (also IPv4-mapped), *.localhost and hosts ending in a number; private addresses stay allowed.

findings.title: A ZDX probe accepted without an id left the half-built custom app behind (rollback deleted a probe with id None, or skipped it)
findings.fix: Probes accepted without an id are looked up on the app by name and removed with it.

findings.title: After Stop, the half-built ZDX app left behind was not named in the run log
findings.fix: The stop branch of the rollback logs the app it did not remove and that Undo removes it.

findings.title: ZDX ids of '.' or '..' passed validation and would have been sent as a path segment
findings.fix: Dot-only ids are refused in the spec, and ZdxApi.send refuses any dot segment before the executor.

findings.title: A 5000-digit version part raised ValueError (int string limit) in the fleet and version-spread checks
findings.fix: version_tuple reads at most four parts of at most nine digits from the first 200 characters.

findings.title: Versions 4.7 and 4.7.0 compared unequal, so devices on one release showed as version drift
findings.fix: version_tuple pads to four parts so trailing zeros compare equal.

findings.title: Device type, registration and app-profile platform codes as floats or DEVICE_TYPE_{OS} read as unknown; 'Darwin' read as Windows
findings.fix: One code_text normaliser for numbers, floats and DEVICE_TYPE_ prefixes; Apple names matched before 'win' at a word start.

findings.title: The forwarding-profile in-use check compared link ids as raw text (7001.0 or ' 7001 ' did not match 7001)
findings.fix: Ids and links are normalised (_ref) before every comparison.

findings.title: Secret values held in a list were shown in the profile drift view
findings.fix: mask_settings masks every scalar of a list under a secret key.

findings.title: Framework fields of the wrong shape raised AttributeError, a string list field was split into letters, values with a trailing newline, a non-boolean switch, any min_tls and format_version true were accepted
findings.fix: load_framework checks fields per type (list, name, boolean, TLS version) with fullmatch; format_version must be the integer 1

findings.title: Undo steps were not validated: a list raised AttributeError and a restore could set a rule's name
findings.fix: _check_step validates shape, ids and field paths, refuses id, name and rank and unknown ATP switches before any read

findings.title: ATP choices were coerced with bool(): the string "false" turned a switch on
findings.fix: atp values must be JSON booleans

findings.title: The same SSL rule picked twice was planned and written twice
findings.fix: moves are de-duplicated by rule id; conflicting targets are refused; ids are short scalars

findings.title: Applying Permissive's ATP turned off a block the tenant had today without a warning
findings.fix: the plan warns for every ATP switch it turns off

findings.title: The ATP PUT was rebuilt from the SDK model, so a setting the model does not know could be reset
findings.fix: read_atp keeps every raw field the model leaves out under its own name

findings.title: Cutting an untrusted title to its byte limit removed one character per pass (quadratic CPU)
findings.fix: _fit_bytes cuts to the limit first, then trims multi-byte characters

findings.title: An unknown tier string was accepted when a framework was given
findings.fix: the tier is one of the four, or 'captured' with a framework

findings.title: An AI Guard Undo could delete any object whose name merely contained AIG-, and an Undo update did not check the object's name
findings.fix: only exact builder names (optional prefix, AIG-, known suffix) may be deleted or put back; updates check the name; the settings object cannot be deleted

findings.title: An AI Guard write did not re-check the object's name before updating it (renamed between re-plan and write)
findings.fix: _h_step marks a renamed object as a conflict

findings.title: AI Guard ids were matched with a `$` regex that accepts a trailing newline (it reaches an SDK path)
findings.fix: ids use fullmatch and refuse booleans

findings.title: Stop while reading the AI Guard routing page ended the job as failed (ai_guard.Stopped was not the engine's Stop)
findings.fix: ops_aiguard maps ai_guard.Stopped to admin_ops.Stopped

findings.title: AI Guard readiness said ready when the proxies, gateways or forwarding rules could not be read
findings.fix: unreadable lists are warnings and ready needs every required check present and passing

findings.title: Baseline areas or Undo areas not ticked were refused only after sign-in: the engine's pre-sign-in check does not pass the spec to a plugin
findings.fix: admin_ops.require_scope gives a plugin's in_scope the spec when its signature takes it (inspect.signature), so the baseline refuses unticked areas and Undo steps before sign-in. Also ...::test_the_engine_scope_check_before_sign_in_passes_the_spec_to_the_baseline

findings.title: A detection policy threshold from the tenant such as 1.2.3 crashed the AI Guard plan (ValueError)
findings.fix: _det_sig compares a non-number threshold as none

findings.title: A captured framework could not be loaded again when a tenant rule name had a less-than or greater-than sign or a value that is not a Zscaler name
findings.fix: capture leaves such a rule out with the reason; capture and load share one field check

findings.title: On a re-run the AI Guard SSL Inspect rule was kept above Do Not Decrypt rules only, not above SSL inspection Block rules
findings.fix: enabled BLOCK rules count as stoppers too

findings.title: Isolate in place of the tier's Block was not flagged as weaker
findings.fix: review flags Block -> Isolate (and Caution)

findings.title: Tenant port strings such as '²' or 5,000 digits made int() raise and ended the whole ZPA read
findings.fix: Ports are parsed from 1-5 ASCII digits within 0-65535; anything else is skipped.

findings.title: Connector versions mixing text and numbers ('23.1', 'beta.1') raised TypeError in the analysis and the overview
findings.fix: Version keys are (0, number) or (1, text) parts, always comparable.

findings.title: Non-finite connector times ('NaN', 'inf') hid a stale, disconnected connector
findings.fix: epoch_seconds returns None for non-finite values.

findings.title: Destination ports written with non-ASCII digits answered Python's int() error instead of a plain sentence
findings.fix: Inline and field ports are ASCII digits; a bad bracketed-IPv6 port is refused in words.

findings.title: IDN host names were refused (diagnosis, Path analyzer and builder) instead of compared in their punycode form
findings.fix: Hosts and segment entries are compared, and the builder stores entries, in punycode.

findings.title: Diagnosis 'why not matched' text was wrong for negated application conditions, OR-joined rules and operands the tool cannot evaluate
findings.fix: Each case has its own sentence; unevaluable operands say 'this tool cannot evaluate', not 'you left as any'.

findings.title: Path analyzer said an On-Net segment bypasses ZPA on a trusted network when the device was off network
findings.fix: The On-Net reason is given only for network 'on'; otherwise the forwarding/access reason.

findings.title: Over-broad check (ZPA-AS-04) flagged no IPv6 subnet except ::/0 (2000::/3 passed clean)
findings.fix: IPv6 /32 or wider is high, /48 or wider medium.

findings.title: admin_ops.execute does not itself require a named assessor (the route does): no defence in depth for the write gate
findings.fix: admin_ops.execute refuses a blank assessor (OperationError) right after the write-mode check, before the client is touched; table-driven over every operation type

findings.title: Remediation recipes offered values ZIA does not take and could crash: the Web DLP rule defaulted to ALERT and offered ISOLATE (not Web DLP actions), the URL rule had no protocols (required by the SDK's add_rule) and offered ISOLATE without an isolation profile, and leaving out an optional number (rank) raised TypeError (HTTP 500) instead of using its default
findings.fix: Web DLP actions ALLOW (default, monitor), BLOCK, CONFIRM; URL rules send protocols ANY_RULE and drop ISOLATE; optional fields take their default before rendering

findings.title: Readiness said 'Will work' for the ZPA builder, ZPA segment moves and the Client Connector builder when that product was not in scope and nothing was checked (even with a read-only role in the token)
findings.fix: a write feature of a product not in scope is 'Not in scope' with the step to tick it

findings.title: Readiness said 'Not checked' for the ZPA builders when the ZPA customer ID was empty, while the ZPA scope itself said 'Will not work'
findings.fix: the ZPA write features are blocked with the customer-ID steps, as the scope is

findings.title: Snapshot compare hid a change: ZIA and ZDX lists with the same name (Locations, departments) and the same counts were taken for one list served twice, so the second was dropped from the rows and the totals
findings.fix: ZDX lists are named as ZDX's; only rows with the same name and the same objects count once

findings.title: POV Prove it recorded 'the configuration agrees with the expected result' for 'Business sites keep working' (and the chat or view tests of the cloud-app runbook) when the Path analyzer found the site blocked
findings.fix: a 'reachable' expectation for the tests whose site must keep working: decrypted and neither blocked nor bypassed

findings.title: The sample tenant answered with field names and shapes the API does not use (ATP phishingSiteBlocked, an SSL rule's decryptSubActions.minTLSVersion, Web DLP URL categories as plain strings), so pages run on the sample read 'known phishing not blocked' and no TLS minimum
findings.fix: knownPhishingSitesBlocked, minClientTLSVersion and minServerTLSVersion, URL category references, checked against the SDK models

findings.title: A bare IPv6 address was refused, and an IPv6 destination became its own URL category and application
findings.fix: Bare IPv6 accepted; an IP literal is resolved as a host, never as a category; IPv4-mapped addresses checked as IPv4

findings.title: Conditional answers said only 'the decision depends on conditions that are not established'
findings.fix: Each reason names the rule, its action and the condition (group, time window, risk score, validity, request method)

findings.title: Data Flow Map tile 'reach ZIA, left encrypted' counted paths the gap list calls unverified; the tiles did not add up to the paths traced
findings.fix: One visibility class per path (data_flow.visibility, the page's own order); blocked, unverified and decrypted-without-DLP tiles added

findings.title: SSL coverage accepted a non-finite protocol volume, giving NaN percentages and JSON that does not parse
findings.fix: A NaN, infinite or negative volume is not counted

findings.title: Port 0 was accepted and silently traced as port 80 or 443
findings.fix: Port 0 is refused in words

findings.title: Test a list traced a row with protocol 'http' as HTTPS (TCP/443)
findings.fix: Protocol http is TCP/80 and https TCP/443 unless a port is given

findings.title: A conditional ZPA answer said 'Depends on who the user is or on facts not given' without naming the rule or the fact
findings.fix: The headline names each earlier rule and the fact it needs, or the VPN On-Net question

findings.title: Dark theme: secondary and semantic text on glass panels and capsule buttons fell to 3.9:1 against the brightest point of the page wash once the sheen (6% white) and the pointer lens (8% white) were added
findings.fix: static/glass.css: dark sheen 2% and lens 4%; a hovered capsule turns more opaque instead of lighter

findings.title: Accent text on --accent-tint (the hero badge, a selected tab) dropped to 4.37 to 4.42:1 over translucent glass in the dark theme, because the tint is itself see-through
findings.fix: static/glass.css: with the glass on, --accent-tint is mixed into the opaque card (14% dark, 12% light), as the status chips are

findings.title: The sticky details panel of the Deploy flow page (an rp-card) was panel-tier glass: with content able to pass behind a sticky surface, its text fell to 2.1:1 in the worst case
findings.fix: static/glass.css: .rp-card.fl-side uses the floating tier (95% / 90% opaque)

findings.title: A backdrop-filter on the sidebar made it the containing block of the sidebar's fixed drag-and-drop marker (sidebar_order.js), so the marker would be placed against the scrolled sidebar instead of the window
findings.fix: static/glass.css: the sidebar keeps the floating tint but no blur (only the still wash is behind it)

findings.title: Blurring every card made a card taller than the window (the Advanced settings card is about 11,000 px) a backdrop-filter render surface the size of the page: headless Chrome drew large black areas, and a GPU may refuse a surface that tall
findings.fix: static/glass.js marks a card or dialog card that fits the window with .glass-fit (ResizeObserver, debounced MutationObserver for new cards); static/glass.css blurs only those

findings.title: The extension's tokens.css said it carried the app's values but did not: white on its dark primary button (#0a84ff) was 3.6:1 and its light success green (#248a3d) 4.4:1 on white, so no backdrop could be added without text failing AA
findings.fix: browser_extension/tokens.css: the app's accessible text and fill colours in both schemes

findings.title: Log analyzer: a DIRECT condition written in a PAC helper function (isCorp(host)) was no longer listed as a bypass
findings.fix: pac_eval.inspect expands a helper's returned conditions once per condition (static, never run; recursion cannot loop)

findings.title: Tenant profiles: a store whose snapshots entry is not an object made the profile list and profile delete fail with 500 (the pre-Wave-5 code ignored the key)
findings.fix: tenant_profiles._read treats a non-object snapshots entry as empty

findings.title: Two IDN encodings: the ZPA analysis, ZPA builder and Bulk changes mapped deviation characters (straße to strasse) while the Path analyzer and browsers keep them (xn--strae-oqa)
findings.fix: zpa_analysis, ops_zpa.check_domain and admin_ops._ascii_host use zia_path_modules.ascii_host / entry_host (UTS 46); the dead fallback in parse_destination is gone

findings.title: Two pack-file readers disagreed: a BOM pack deployed but failed the Terraform export and the library; a non-text name was refused by deploy but rendered by the export
findings.fix: pack_terraform, pack_library, dlp_importer and tools/fan_out_channels.py read through pack_deploy.load_pack_file

findings.title: remediation.execute kept a dead PATCH branch with a weaker read check, and the preview showed a description-only PUT body without saying the rule is read and sent back whole
findings.fix: PATCH branch removed (a PATCH recipe is refused, nothing sent); plan() and the dry run carry a merge note shown in the previews and the queue item

findings.title: Live path steps drawn as not reached, not in scope or pending faded their text to 1.5 to 3.6:1, yet they are focusable buttons
findings.fix: static/flow_anim.css: only the outline fades (dotted or dashed); the title and line keep full --text and --dim

findings.title: The help line of every write control named three gates (no writer) and promised a typed confirmation that self-heal Undo does not ask for; heal and queue apply left out the writer or the assessor
findings.fix: static/hover_help.js names write mode, a writer, the named assessor and the confirmation; the heal, Undo and queue apply entries name their writer and assessor

findings.title: The confirmation-phrase help and the dialog's error said to type it with the underscores (I UNDERSTAND has a space), and the help called the consent step tenant-free
findings.fix: help_catalog.js: Type the phrase shown above exactly as shown, with a new confirm effect line; ui_auth.js: Type it exactly as shown above

findings.title: The HAR import help, button title, OVERVIEW and server comment said only host names and request counts are sent; methods, schemes and upload amounts are sent too
